audit_result.proof_trace: discord_uid is extracted directly from req.body (line 10) with only a null check; authMiddleware enforces a single shared API_AUTH_TOKEN but sets no identity context on req, so there is no caller-bound field to cross-check the UID against. Any holder of the API key can trigger role sync for any arbitrary Discord UID without being bound to their own identity.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker who obtains API_AUTH_TOKEN (e.g., via git history leak, CI log exposure, or the default CORS '*' policy enabling credential theft) sends POST /api/roles/sync with { "discord_uid": "<target_uid>" }, triggering unauthorized role assignment or removal for any Discord member based on their DB state.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-019.text: syncRoles discord_uid from request body must not be trusted without cross-checking auth context.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-019.assertion: forall req: syncRoles(req.body.discord_uid) => uid validated against auth context
